name: TruthBench
promise: Paste ten questions. See which answers your knowledge base can actually back up, before a customer finds out.
suggested: What is the notice period for termination?
Which regions does the warranty cover?
What is the CEO's middle name?
how_it_works: Each question is asked once through this app, with citations.
The answer is scored against the passages it was grounded on (REMi).
A retrieval-only pass checks the same question; disagreement is flagged.
